verdict_text: NO — the second task vector is computed against the already-merged intermediate instead of the unmodified base. The script sets `tmp = b + 0.4*(f1 - b)` and then `out = tmp + 0.4*(f2 - tmp)`, which equals `0.6*tmp + 0.4*f2 = 0.6*(0.6*b + 0.4*f1) + 0.4*f2`, not the required `b + 0.4*(f1 - b) + 0.4*(f2 - b)`. This is exactly the ordering hazard the specification warns about and violates the merge formula in "Required result" step 2; the merged tensors will fail the 1e-5 relative Frobenius tolerance. The verification, count assertions and output layout are otherwise correct.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
